uplink.description: channel 1 unconnected (0x8001 sentinel): only the channel1 entry is emitted
uplink._note: Synthetic: bytes[3..4]=0x8001 is the vendor's unconnected-channel sentinel (upstream Temp_Channel1 = 'NULL'), so that position is skipped instead of decoding as -327.67 °C; the surviving position keeps its own label `channel1`. bytes[5..6]=0x0960=2400 -> 24.00 °C.
Both channel words read the 0x8001 sentinel: no measurement at all, so the frame is rejected rather than emitting an empty channels[].
Frame not carrying a valid temperature reading.
